'''HK-47's Droid Army''' was an army of [[HK-series assassin droid]]s that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Created in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] by an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] designated [[HK-47]], the army was destroyed in the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="Obi" />
